intro: Our passion for supply chain excellence is fuelled by our belief that the supply chain sector has a key role to play in driving economic growth and ensuring a more sustainable future.
csr_framework_heading: The strategic thrusts of our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) charter are characterised by the 3Es:
philosophy: When it comes to industry talent, Freyer International believes in the mantra, "Teach a man to fish" rather than "give the man a fish".
commitment: Freyer Internaitonal is committed to nurturing talents through the support of logistics and supply chain education and skills upgrading. We believe in being socially responsible and giving back to the community at-large.
